shops.name: Songbird
shops.note: Menu mentions matcha: latte and rose soda, made with Frame Matcha (Raleigh)
shops.notes: Overture files it as a bar, so the cafe menu pass never read it. Address, hours, Instagram handle (songbird.nc) and the Frame Matcha purveyor line are on its own site (songbird.bar, /location-hours, /purveyors); the morning menu is a picture on /morning-menu and lists a matcha latte (frame matcha, $7) and a seasonal rose matcha soda ($8). Also at visitraleigh.com/listing/songbird/78948/ (same address).
